editorial:
Imagine living a double life where you spend your nights pretending to be drunk just to catch bad guys in the act. That is exactly what you get with Cassie, a woman who stopped her life in its tracks after a horrible event happened to her best friend in college. She spends her time teaching a lesson to men who think they can take advantage of women. The vibe is a weird mix of bright colors and candy-coated looks, but underneath it all, there is a very dark and serious story about revenge and justice. It feels like a puzzle that slowly puts itself together as you watch.

Carey Mulligan is amazing in this role because she can switch from sweet to scary in a heartbeat. The plot has some big twists that you will not see coming, and the pacing keeps you on the edge of your seat. Some parts might feel a bit slow or uncomfortable, but that is the point. If you love movies that make you think and feel a bit uneasy, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Cassie eventually records a confession from the man who hurt her friend. Even though he tries to pay her off, she uses the recording to get him arrested. However, the plan comes at a high cost because Cassie is killed during the process. The movie ends with her friend's rapist going to jail, showing that while she lost her life, she finally got the justice she wanted for her best friend.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and smart plot twists.
